title: Balsamic Honey Vinaigrette
summary: Balsamic vinegar steeped with shallot and garlic, sweetened with honey and whisked with olive oil into a rich, dark dressing.
equipment: whisk or jar with a lid

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Steep the aromatics
steps.text: Combine the balsamic vinegar, shallot, garlic, salt and pepper in the bowl and leave for 10 min so the shallot softens and flavours the vinegar.

steps.title: Add honey and mustard
steps.text: Whisk in the honey and mustard until blended.

steps.title: Emulsify
steps.text: Trickle in the olive oil while whisking constantly until thick and evenly blended. Alternatively, shake everything vigorously in a lidded jar.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour into a small jug and dress green leaves, tomatoes or roasted vegetables. Shake or whisk again if it separates.

tips: Inexpensive balsamic works well here; save aged balsamic for drizzling neat.
For a sharper dressing, use 1 tsp honey.
It is also good brushed over grilled vegetables or halloumi.
Add a few chopped basil leaves for a summery version.
storage: Store in a sealed jar in the fridge for up to 1 week. Bring to room temperature and shake well before using. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
